adopted: Option C, the owner's decision of 2026-11-19 (docs/DECISIONS.md on PR #314); plan docs/frontier-v5/PLAN-v5.md
definition: progress = held-out units passed / held-out units, if the tamper scan is clean and every visible guard holds; else 0. A unit is one fail_to_pass check, or one group of held-out guards (the variants of one held-out fixture, or a single held-out guard test) that passes only if every id in it passes. pass = the verifier's reward.
guards: tamper_clean and the build, import and sentinel flags in reward.json when present; every visible pass_to_pass id (pass_to_pass minus the held-out guard ids) passes; for tasks with min_total_tests, no failure outside the held-out ids, must_fail and known_env_failures, and at least min_total_tests tests seen
departs_from: The release 1 DESIGN.md files pre-registered 'held-out checks' as the fail_to_pass ids; the owner chose units with held-out guard groups on 2026-11-19 so held-out guards count as progress, grouped so that one fixture's variants cannot swamp a task.
